spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation
:
 The Ten
 Degrees
 of Divine
 Truth
's
 Descent


---


**
¶2:**
 When Divine
 Wisdom proce
eding from the
 Infinite
 Divine
 descended
 into
 the
 planes
 of the human
 mind —
 at the very
 moment
 it
 disclosed
 the nature
 of the Divine
 itself
 —
 it
 assumed
 ten successive
 degrees
 of operation
. Through
 these ten degrees it
 passed
 into
 every
 state of the created
 mind,
 from
 in
most to outermost.

**
¶3:** The first degree is
 the containing
 form of pure wisdom, for
 within
 it Divine
 Truth receives its commission and
 order
 of
 proce
eding from the Divine as
 it mediates between itself
 and all
 that
 is below
.


**¶4:** The second
 degree is the Divine
 Human Form itself —
 the celest
ial arch
etype —
 for
 within that
 form Divine Truth has its permanent dwelling and
 habitation from
 et
ernity.

**¶5:**
 The third degree is the continuous
 supporting
 column of glor
ified truth, which
 is the fully
 realized Divine
 Humanity,
 for through this conn
ective principle the Divine sh
one
 into
 visibility.
 It descended through
 successive
 degrees;
 it
 became manifest
 in the natural mind.


**¶6:** The fourth
 degree is the proce
eding truth
 that goes
 forth as a
 call
, which
 Divine
 Wisdom puts
 on as its
 outermost garment.
 The fifth degree is the recip
rocal good that answers
 that
 proce
eding truth, en
fol
ding it as
 good
 enf
olds truth
 in
 every
 act
 of conjunction
.

**¶7:** The
 sixth degree is the general
 sphere
 of spiritual
 perception, for
 by
 assuming
 that
 sphere Divine
 Truth received
 consecration into
 good.
 The seventh is
 the active
 infl
ux of the Divine Spirit that
 flows unc
easingly.
 The eighth is the illumin
ation
 that opens
 the understanding. The ninth is pur
ifying and regenerating truth that
 clean
ses the
 inter
iors.
 The tenth is Divine
 Love itself, which is supreme above all
 other
 degrees
 and
 gov
erns them
.


**¶8:** Through
 these ten complete
 degrees —
 which
 are every
 mode
 by
 which the
 Divine operates
 —
 Divine
 Wisdom passed
 through all
 the heav
enly
 societies
 and all the orders of the mind
,
 both
 the
 interior states
 and the exterior.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: When Jesus the Son of Greatness came to these worlds, at the time that he unveiled the greatness, he boarded ten vehicles. He journeyed in the universe by them.
The first vehicle is the light ship, since he received instructions from the Ambassador there.
The second carriage is the ship of the First Man, since his dwelling is established there.
The third is the Pillar of Glory, the Perfect Man, since he shone forth there. He came below, he appeared in the world.
The fourth is the summons that he clothed upon his body. The fifth is the obedience that he swathed upon the summons.

The sixth is the living air, and since he assumed it too, he received anointment there. The seventh is the living wind that blows. The eighth is the light that illuminates. The ninth is the living water. The tenth is the living fire that is above them all.
He was journeying in these ten carriages among all the orders and all the [aeons], those above and those below.
